limitations.text: No verified image of 桌 or an identified historical form of 桌 is available to explain its graphic history. 卓 forms cannot stand in for 桌: the furniture word is reported in historical spellings 倚卓 and 倚棹, while available evidence does not establish a dated sequence showing how the graph 桌 arose. The proposed change from 卓 to 桌 by replacing or merging 十 with 木 remains unsupported.
